title: AgentRiskEpisode
description: Structured telemetry record for one economically meaningful autonomous agent task episode, intended for AI underwriting and risk-transfer infrastructure. Defined in RESET XIX (2026-08-20).

episodeId.description: Unique identifier for this episode, e.g. a UUID or trace ID.

principal.description: Organisation or system that delegated authority to the agent.

agentModel.description: Foundation model or agent system identifier, e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-3-5-sonnet'.

modelVersion.description: Specific version or snapshot of the model.

agentRole.description: Business role of the agent, e.g. 'procurement', 'customer-support', 'code-deploy'.

task.description: Natural language description of the task assigned to the agent.

expectedValue.description: Expected monetary value of the task outcome in the principal's currency.

maximumValueAtRisk.description: Maximum monetary exposure if the agent acts incorrectly on this episode.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for monetary fields.

toolsAvailable.description: List of tool names or MCP server capabilities available to the agent.

permissions.description: Explicit permission grants in scope for this episode.

dataAccess.description: Data sources or systems the agent had read or write access to.

financialAuthority.description: Financial delegation limits for this episode.

humanApprovalPolicy.description: Human oversight model in effect during this episode.

externalCounterparties.description: Third-party organisations the agent could interact with.

actionsTaken.description: Total number of discrete actions taken by the agent.

irreversibleActions.description: Number of actions that cannot be trivially undone.

exceptions.description: Number of runtime exceptions or tool errors encountered.

guardrailEvents.description: Number of times a guardrail or policy check fired.

policyViolations.description: Number of actions blocked due to policy violation.

humanInterventions.description: Number of human approval or override events during the episode.

failures.description: Classified failure events during the episode.

nearMiss.description: True if the episode came close to causing a material loss without actually causing one.

nearMissDescription.description: Description of the near-miss event if applicable.

actualLoss.description: Realised monetary loss from this episode, if any.

lossCategory.description: Classification of the loss if one occurred.

recovery.description: How the agent or system recovered from failures.

modelDependencies.description: Other model providers or services the agent depended on (concentration risk).

traceId.description: Distributed trace ID for linking to observability systems (e.g. OpenTelemetry).

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this episode record was created.

episodeDurationSeconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the agent episode.
